master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create Level05 of a 2D hand-painted ancient forest platformer, using IMAGE1 as the exact geometry and IMAGE2 ONLY as art style. Very wide 2048x768, aspect 8:3, include the whole sky band above the guide. Keep all GREEN ground shapes and the TWO lower beige fixed caps exactly where image1 places them. The upper small beige slab with dashed right-pointing movement arrow is a MOVING object: OMIT it and leave that entire upper space clear. Also remove the wind arrows themselves. Do not replace excluded moving objects with terrain.
Layout: left starting bank rising to a higher step at its right end; a wide open gap; a very narrow tall central pier with a broad fixed cap; a second wide gap down to the bottom; then a broad right terrain mass whose left side is a narrow pier with overhanging fixed cap, lower inset step to its right, then tall exit plateau. The two big gaps stay completely open to the bottom. No floor connecting anything, no extra platforms, no border. Precisely preserve all fixed platform widths and relative heights from the guide. Modest open stone arch at the yellow exit outline, no door/magical seal.
Distinct landscape: airy sunlit windswept woodland valley, graceful leaning willows and broadleaf trees, distant blue-green hills, fewer ancient ruins, a dry central ravine with layered rock channels ready for separate animated water. Lush yet open, bright turquoise sky and warm green canopy, long subtle painted sun rays. Beautiful moss-covered natural cliffs mixed with carved weathered stone, thin clear grass platform tops, small ferns and flowers, a few wooden diagonal braces. Style/detail/light quality match IMAGE2 but composition follows IMAGE1. Frame only upper corners with foliage, leave route clear. No painted water/waterfalls/mist sprites/particles or hanging animated strands in this static image. No text, arrows, grids, labels, UI, characters, hazards/spikes, movable blocks, mechanisms, levers, plates, elevators, gems. 2D side elevation, no 3D/isometric/pixel style.
static:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the exact near gameplay environment from this master image onto REAL transparent alpha. Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Do not redesign or shift anything, do not add structure, do not fill pits. Keep the sunlit thin platform tops exactly. No water, text, characters, grid, effects. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.
Keep exactly three terrain masses and two fixed platform caps, with two open bottom-reaching gaps. Background rocks between those masses are distant scenery: remove them from this cutout. Do not add the omitted upper moving slab. Small hanging ivy attached to platform stone can stay static.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant willow woodland ruins placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions. Also remove near corner framing branches/tree trunk. The resulting image has only distant non-walkable soft painted forest and ancient atmospheric ruins. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
